tailLossBehavior: This local one-key projection requires the exact positively installed issuer anchor, immutable partition baseline including its owner-installed initial mutation revision, and complete SQL-registered current unretired reservation set. Existing baseline fields must all remain present and exact. A locally registered pending field may be absent or exact; an unretired completed SQL issuer-local release may appear only as its retained exact RELEASED capacity postimage with its binding absent; an authorized retired terminal capacity field is absent only with its exact retained original retirement proof. Every ADD compares and advances the partition-local opaque physical revision atomically with its one-key change, so an older prepared ADD or release cannot replay after a later release or retirement. Missing baseline/header/revision, legacy or malformed values, unknown fields, current source or incarnation movement, or incomplete SQL accounting leaves the operation unqualified. The result is physical readback evidence only; it does not acknowledge issuer-wide coverage, open a barrier, or authorize admission.
